# **`arknpi`**

## Installation

You can install **`arknpi`** from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("andrewallenbruce/arknpi")
```

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the arktax project is released with a [Contributor Code
of
Conduct](https://contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html).
By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`entity_recode()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/entity_recode.md)
  : Recode NPI entity codes
- [`make_case()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/make_case.md)
  : Make a case statement
- [`make_phone()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/make_phone.md)
  : Format a 10-digit phone number
- [`make_purpose()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/make_purpose.md)
  : Make an Address Purpose Column
- [`make_zip()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/make_zip.md)
  : Format a 9-digit zip code
- [`other_id_type()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/other_id_type.md)
  : NPPES Other Identifier Type
- [`other_name_type()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/other_name_type.md)
  : NPPES Other Name Type
- [`phone_eq_10()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/phone_eq_10.md)
  : Format a 10-digit phone number
- [`phone_gt_10()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/phone_gt_10.md)
  : Format a 10-digit phone number
- [`remove_periods()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/remove_periods.md)
  : Remove periods
- [`wrap()`](https://andrewallenbruce.github.io/arknpi/reference/wrap.md)
  : Wrap a string
